en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a gently curving cobblestone road lined with late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century townhouses and shopfronts. Signs in German advertise a restaurant and various businesses. A man in a white coat and a child stand in front of a building on the left. In the distance, a Baroque‑style church tower rises above the roofs. The overall look suggests a historic Central European town.
